entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: One of two satellites of Dominaria, originally the Thran Null Sphere used to monitor artifact creatures, later flung into orbit.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Thran capital near which the Null Sphere stood.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Took control of the Null Sphere and later became godlike in his Black Cloud of Death.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Erected Temple Faralyn and called the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Believed the moon's white mana could slay Yawgmoth and flew the Weatherlight through it.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that punched through the moon; its consciousness died.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: Empire whose artifact creatures the Sphere controlled.

entities.name: Battle of the Null Sphere
entities.description: Yawgmoth's seizure of the Null Sphere.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War during which Yawgmoth took the Sphere.

entities.name: Planeswalkers' War
entities.description: War begun when a summit on the moon descended into violence.

events.summary: Yawgmoth takes control of the Null Sphere in the Battle of the Null Sphere and turns artifact creatures on their masters.
events.quote: Yawgmoth took control of it in what is known as the Battle of the Null Sphere

events.summary: The Sphere's operators rebel and jettison it into orbit; the stonechargers wipe out Yawgmoth's army and mutate survivors into warped Phyrexians.
events.quote: the irradiative cloud released by the stonechargers mutated the survivors into the iconically warped Phyrexians

events.summary: A planeswalkers' summit on the moon called by Faralyn descends into violence and begins the Planeswalkers' War.
events.quote: which descended into violence and began the Planeswalkers' War

events.summary: Gerrard flies the Weatherlight through the moon, channeling its white mana into Yawgmoth; it fails to kill him and ends the Weatherlight's consciousness.
events.quote: only resulted in the death of Weatherlight' s consciousness

relations.quote: Such was the wonder of Glacian ’s design.

relations.note: Attacked him with the moon's mana.
relations.quote: Gerrard Capashen believed could be used to slay the now-godlike Yawgmoth
